buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 2 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 3. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 4. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 5. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors.

vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 6. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 7. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 3 samples for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 10 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) 1. The Bid is for Bed Sheet Double Bed with following specifications in addition to mentioned in document:- ​Bed sheet Size- 220*240cm±5CM GSM - 110±5% Pillow Cover 2 Pillow Cover Size- 45*70cm ±5CM Packing - 1*1 Cardboard Box Colour- Multi Colours Whenever there occurs difference in Specification of Bid and ATC, the value of ATC will be considered fi nal for evaluation. 2. The bidders should not be banned / suspended / blacklisted by any organization. Kindly upload a declar ation on letterhead duly signed by the authorized person with a stamp while submitting the tender docume nts. 3. If bidders submit the tender, it will be deemed that the bidder has fully understood all the requirements a nd T&C. 4. Enhancement of rate will not be allowed once the financial bid is accepted and the purchase order is plac ed. 5. Bidders will be bound to supply the item in multi-colours in proportionate of the purchase order. 6. Please note the quantity of supply will have to be strictly as per order placed. Any excess supply other th an ordered will not be accepted. The seller will have to take back excess supply at its own cost. However,

the buyer may increase or decrease (25%) the quantity of scheduled order as per its need and the seller is bound to fulfill the order. 7. Bidder must offer its rate inclusive of applicable GST only. 8. No Advance payment shall be made. Payment will be made within 45 days subject to receipt of full article s as ordered. 9. TDS shall be deducted as per rules. 10. Advance sample will have to be delivered within 3 days from the date of GeM contract genera tion by the selected vendor before commencement of work order on the following address: Manager (Sales), LIC of India, Divisional Office, "Jeevan Prakash", Jaipur Road, Bikaner-334001 (Raj). 11. Submission of advance Sample by bidder and Approval from buyer’s e nd is MANDATORY condition, failing which bid may be disqualified. 12. In case, due to some unforeseen circumstances happen to be holiday/closed day, the items will be deliver ed on the next working day within working hours i.e. 10.00 to 17.30 Hrs. 13. Supply of the article has to be made within the given time frame at Divisional Office- Bikaner on above ad dress on seller's cost. 14. In case the supplied material is found damaged/unusable in any form, the whole consignment will have to be taken back by the seller at its own cost. 15. In case the consignment is taken back by the seller for whatever reason, the seller will have to supply the order afresh and LD charges will be deducted/recovered for delayed period as per GeM GTC. 16. Loading and Unloading, Transportation charges, all taxes, duties & other charges shall be borne by bidder . 17. Liquidated Damages - If the seller fails to deliver any or all of the goods within the original/fixed delivery p eriod specified in the contract, the buyer will be entitled to deduct/recover the liquidated damages for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure conditions, at 0.5% of the contract value of delayed quantity p er week or part of the week of delayed period as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contrac t value of delayed quantity without any controversy/dispute of any sort whatsoever. 18. In the event that the goods are not supplied within 45 days from the date of purchase order, the tender wil l be cancelled and suitable action will be taken as per GeM provisions. 19. Any transportation loss shall be the responsibility of supplier & have to borne by them. 20. Any damage observed after unpacking at buyer's end shall be replaced by the vendor at it's own cost. 21. The delivered item should exactly matched with Technical Specification as mentioned in Gem Contract & as per approved Sample, failing to which LIC have sole right to reject the consignment/impose appropriate penalty/blacklist the firm apart from seizer of EMD amount. 22. Delivery instructions for Supplier / Transporters- Delivery Timing & Working Hours :- i) LIC of India, Divisional Office, Bikaner working for 5 days in a week (Saturday & Sunday are weekly offs) ii) Material delivery can be accepted only in working days (Monday-Friday) excluding public Holidays betw een 10.00 to 17.00 hours 23. The Sr. Divisional Manager (I/C) reserves the right to accept the lowest quotation as per bid specification o r to cancel the Bid without assigning any reason thereof. 24. The bidders are required to accept the Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) and specification regarding th e article. Kindly upload a declaration on letterhead duly signed by the authorized person with a stamp whil e submitting the tender documents.
